description.tr: 18. yüzyıl Fas'ının ve Avrupa ile diplomatik ilişkilerinin kesin tarihini yazdı || Zeyyânî bizzat İstanbul ve İspanya'ya seyahat eden bir diplomattı. || [Tarih notu] Uzun ömrü (99 yaşında vefat) bir yüzyıllık Fas tarihine ilk elden tanıklık ettiği anlamına gelir.
description.en: Wrote the definitive history of 18th-century Morocco and its diplomatic relations with Europe — a rare first-person account of Maghribi statecraft from a practitioner || al-Zayyani was himself a diplomat who traveled to Istanbul and Spain. His work provides the Moroccan perspective on the age of European colonial expansion. || [Historiographical note] His longevity (died at 99) meant he witnessed a century of Moroccan history firsthand.
description.ar: كتب التاريخ الشامل للمغرب في القرن الثامن عشر وعلاقاته الدبلوماسية مع أوروبا || كان الزياني نفسه دبلوماسياً سافر إلى إسطنبول وإسبانيا
